title: GTA 6 Devs Had Freedom to Add Cool Features Just Like Rdr2
description: Rockstar Games gave GTA 6 developers so much freedom to add cool details that not even top executives are aware of everything in the game.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Development Freedom: The Secret Behind Rockstar's Massive Open World

As the gaming community eagerly awaits the launch of *Grand Theft Auto VI*, new insights into the title's development process have emerged. According to reports from IGN Games, Rockstar Games provided the *GTA 6* development team with an extraordinary level of freedom. This autonomy allowed developers to implement cool features and intricate details much like the famous horse mechanics seen in *Red Dead Redemption 2*.

### A Decentralized Approach to World-Building

The scale of modern open-world games makes comprehensive top-down management nearly impossible. As highlighted in recent discussions, "there's no one person that has this whole thing in their head." Because Rockstar empowered its developers to freely add creative and engaging features, even the studio's top executives are not fully aware of every single detail and easter egg built into the vast expanse of the game.

### Carrying the Torch of Immersive Realism

This design philosophy echoes the meticulous attention to detail that defined *Red Dead Redemption 2*. By fostering an environment where creators can act on their passion for immersive realism without bureaucratic bottlenecks, Rockstar ensures that its virtual worlds feel alive, unpredictable, and packed with emergent gameplay possibilities. 

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's willingness to trust frontline developers with creative freedom is precisely what sets their open-world games apart from the competition. When creators are given the space to add passion projects and hidden mechanics into a game like *GTA 6*, the result is a living, breathing digital ecosystem that continues to surprise players long after launch.
